senses.gloss: f. = h. קִרְיָה, town, settlement, village. Targ. II Esth. IV, 1. Ib. IX, 28.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 18:19">Targ. Prov. XVIII, 19</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוה עייל ק׳ ונפיק ק׳</he> (not <he>ונפקא</he>) he went from place to place; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:4">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>הוה עליל לק׳ ונפיק לק׳</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:14:3">Ib. to V, 14</cite> <he>למזבן עיבור מן ק׳</he> to buy up the grain of the place; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S02056"><he>קִרְיָין</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00596"><he>קוּ׳</he></cite>, <he>קִרְיָיתָא קוֹ׳</he>, <cite ref="S02085"><he>קִרְיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00089"><he>קִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 35:2">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXXV, 2</cite> (not <he>קִרְיָת</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 35:7">Targ. Y. ib. 7</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 35:8">8</cite>; a. fr.—Constr. <he>קוּרְיֵי</he>, <cite ref="S00336"><he>קוֹ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 32:26">Targ. Y. ib. XXXII, 26</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 32:33">33</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 32:36">36</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="S01923"><he>קִרְוָא</he></cite>.—Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ <he>ר׳ יודה</he> … <he>בק׳ דארעא וכ׳</he> R. Judah, the Nasi sent forth … to visit the small places of Palestine and arrange for them primary teachers &c.; Lam. R. introd. (R. Abba 2).
Succ. 44ᵇ ק׳ אית לי I own villages (or sing.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> <he>דנפקין וסחרין … קוריין וכ׳</he> who go out trading in four or five places (during the day) and sleep in their own homes; a. e.
